text.p: Belgian holding company Definance said on Wednesday it had acquired, through its 59 percent owned Deficom unit, a minority interest in Canal Plus Poland.
In a statement Definance said the interest was held through Polcom Invest, a company in which Deficom had an indirect 49 percent stake.
"This significant investment has cost Polcom Invest a global amount of around $71 million," Definance said.
Definance said Polcom Invest could cut its holding to around 30 percent by placing some Canal Plus Poland shares with other Polish investors.
"If Canal Plus Poland meets its forecasts, this investment should allow Deficom to realise significant capital gains over the next few years," Definance said.
Pay TV station Canal Plus Poland, launched in 1994, already has nearly 140,000 subscribers.
Definance holds a large stake in Canal Plus Belgium.

Our original story dated January 15 has been withdrawn. The corrected version makes clear that Definance acquired a minority rather than a controlling interest. -- Nick Antonovics, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6817, Fax +32 2 230 7710
